note.ja: 22モデル族の文献解説に、ロジスティック増殖・閉鎖SIR、線形反応拡散、Schnakenbergの線形発現・有限振幅の非線形発展・成長後の1次元パターン、空間なしFitzHugh–Nagumoの限定例を接続します。全22族の実装ではありません。 別群small-modelsから、固定した4状態酵素/QSSA、正のLotka–Volterra軌道、SEIR保存則と初期2モード線形化の3例だけを追加します。SEIRはSIRの既存実行範囲とは別です。 別群biology-ode-controls/biology-space-controlsでは、Hodgkin–Huxley、移入–死亡SSA、Fisher特殊速度前線、2次元Schnakenberg、外力付きKeller–Segelの固定例だけを追加します。未達・未解決の目標も保持します。
note.en: The 22-family survey links scoped examples of logistic growth, closed SIR, linear reaction–diffusion, linear Schnakenberg onset, finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth 1D patterns, plus spatially uniform FitzHugh–Nagumo. This does not implement all 22 families. Three further fixed examples from the separate small-models group cover four-state enzyme/QSSA, a positive Lotka–Volterra orbit, and SEIR conservation with full two-mode early linearization. SEIR is separate from the existing SIR execution scope. Separate biology-ode-controls/biology-space-controls groups add only fixed Hodgkin–Huxley, immigration–death SSA, special-speed Fisher, two-dimensional Schnakenberg and forced Keller–Segel cases. Unmet and unresolved goals remain visible.

Independent orthonormal sine/cosine Galerkin references retain four K12/18,Q96/192,tolerance rows for every initial condition. The original Dirichlet K12/18 reference failed its first relative qualification. Preserve that failure and add four D-only K24/32,Q128/192 reference actions.

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes
